title: Rooms Info — payload
description: A member asks a room's host what it holds about the room: its tier, its current epoch, the limits the host applies to its files, and how much of them the room and the member have used.

roomId.description: The room's identifier. The host verifies the presentation against credentials issued by this identifier, never against a member list of its own.

presentation.description: Must confer the `read` action at this room's scope.

roomId.description: The room this describes, echoed so a response cannot be mistaken for another room's.

retentionPolicy.description: Absent means `chained`, as everywhere in this family.

epoch.description: The room's current epoch as the host knows it: the one a record or file must be sealed under to be accepted now.

limits.description: The limits the host applies to this room, after any override for the room and capped by the host-wide ceiling. `member` here is the room's default per-member allowance; the presenter's own, which may differ, is under `usage.member.limits`.

member.description: The presenter's own use and allowance: charged to the subject at the root of the presented chain, so an agent sees its member's figures. Absent on a `private` room, where the host does not know which member is asking.

limits.description: The limits that apply to this member in this room: an override set for them by the host's administrators if there is one, else the room's per-member default.
